question: L has two children and he is the only son of G, who is the father-in-law of T. T has only one son. T is the mother of P. Q is not the granddaughter of G. P and Q are siblings. How is T related to Q?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be3e2a8637de8c903ba3c804fd8a084584fc9415c4edcc89bec648f945d518d7.png] 

Clearly, T is the mother of Q.

Hence, ‘**Mother**’ is the correct answer.
